<div class="wrap">
<h1>Material agreements 8-K</h1>
<p class="sub">Current-window Form 8-K Item 1.01 rows from the live EDGAR tape. Deal $, MoM, QoQ and YoY stay blank because this tape has no contract value and no dated agreement series. Click any header to sort. Company names remain as filed; no ticker is inferred.</p>
<input id="q" placeholder="Filter company or accession" autocomplete="off">
<p id="status" class="sub" role="status">Loading /data/8k-filings.json</p>
<div id="board" class="table-region">Loading stored publication.</div>
<div class="foot"><b>Built for:</b> listing current-window Item 1.01 material agreements, with sortable columns, without inventing a contract value or a growth rate.<br>
<b>Data:</b> /data/8k-filings.json filings[] filtered to items containing 1.01 (company, accession, filed_at, items, filing_url). No deal_value, amount, or agreement-history field exists on that packet.<br>
<b>Blank columns:</b> Deal $ / MoM / QoQ / YoY are reserved and stay empty. A 7-day item tape cannot produce month, quarter or year change in agreement dollars. Document Size in the Atom snippet is filing kilobytes, not a deal value, and is not shown as dollars.<br>
<b>Not:</b> an 8-K body parser, a purchase-price extract, or a confirmed closing. Research only.</div>
</div>
<script>
function esc(s){return String(s==null?"":s).replace(/[&<>"]/g,function(c){return {"&":"&","<":"<",">":">",'"':"""}[c];});}
function hasItem(row,code){return Array.isArray(row&&row.items)&&row.items.indexOf(code)>=0;}
function secOk(u){return typeof u==="string"&&/^https:\/\/(?:www\.)?sec\.gov\/Archives\/edgar\/data\/\d+\//.test(u);}
function cmp(a,b,k,dir){
  var av=a[k],bv=b[k];
  if(av==null||av===""){if(bv==null||bv==="")return String(a.company||"").localeCompare(String(b.company||""));return 1;}
  if(bv==null||bv==="")return -1;
  if(typeof av==="number"&&typeof bv==="number")return (av-bv)*dir;
  return String(av).localeCompare(String(bv))*dir;
}
(async function(){
  var d=null,SORT="filed_at",DIR=-1;
  try{var r=await fetch("/data/8k-filings.json?t="+Date.now(),{cache:"no-store"});if(r.ok)d=await r.json();}catch(e){}
  var all=(d&&Array.isArray(d.filings))?d.filings:[];
  var rows=all.filter(function(x){return hasItem(x,"1.01");}).map(function(x){
    return {company:x.company||"",filed_at:x.filed_at||"",accession:x.accession||"",items:Array.isArray(x.items)?x.items:[],filing_url:x.filing_url||"",deal_usd:null,mom:null,qoq:null,yoy:null};
  });
  var COLS=[["filed_at","Filed"],["company","Company / SEC document"],["deal_usd","Deal $"],["mom","MoM %"],["qoq","QoQ %"],["yoy","YoY %"],["items","Items"],["accession","Accession"]];
  function paint(){
    var q=(document.getElementById("q").value||"").toUpperCase();
    var list=rows.filter(function(x){return !q||(x.company+" "+x.accession).toUpperCase().indexOf(q)>=0;}).slice().sort(function(a,b){return cmp(a,b,SORT,DIR);});
    var h="<table><thead><tr>";
    COLS.forEach(function(c){
      h+="<th class='"+(SORT===c[0]?"on":"")+"' data-k="+c[0]+">"+c[1]+(SORT===c[0]?(DIR>0?" \u2191":" \u2193"):"")+"</th>";
    });
    h+="</tr></thead><tbody>";
    list.forEach(function(x){
      var name=esc(x.company);
      var link=secOk(x.filing_url)?'<a href="'+esc(x.filing_url)+'" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">'+name+"</a>":name;
      var items=x.items.map(function(it){return "<span class=item>"+esc(it)+"</span>";}).join("");
      h+="<tr><td>"+esc(x.filed_at)+"</td><td>"+link+"</td><td class=muted></td><td class=muted></td><td class=muted></td><td class=muted></td><td>"+items+"</td><td>"+esc(x.accession)+"</td></tr>";
    });
    document.getElementById("board").innerHTML=h+"</tbody></table>";
    document.getElementById("status").textContent=list.length+" of "+all.length+" received 8-Ks carry Item 1.01. Deal $, MoM, QoQ and YoY are blank — those fields are not in the tape. Click headers to sort.";
    document.querySelectorAll("#board th[data-k]").forEach(function(th){
      th.onclick=function(){if(SORT===th.getAttribute("data-k"))DIR=-DIR;else{SORT=th.getAttribute("data-k");DIR=SORT==="filed_at"?-1:1;}paint();};
    });
  }
  if(!all.length){document.getElementById("board").textContent="8k-filings.json missing or filings[] empty.";document.getElementById("status").textContent="No filing conclusion is available from this failed read.";return;}
  document.getElementById("q").oninput=paint;paint();
})();
</script>
